THE EXPLOSIVE ORDINANCE

REGULATION made by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 33 of the Explosive Ordinance, No. 21 of 1956, I,Maithreepala Sirisena, Minister of Defence of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.
MAITHREEPALA SIRISENA,President,Minister of Defence.Colombo,14th September 2016.
